resolutions.researcher_notes: StartYear1=1993 does not match any documented PGU milestone in the two independent sources that give a construction timeline. Wikipedia (independent secondary source): Phase I completed 1984 (Kertih GPP + 32 km pipeline), Phase II completed 1992 (extension west/south to Singapore), Phase III completed 1998 (Meru→Perlis extension, i.e. the segment that reaches this row's own EndLocation). Oil & Gas Journal (independent trade press, contemporaneous ~1996 reporting on Stage III): Stage III Sector 1 (Meru→Lumut, 184 km + Segari lateral) completed Q1 1996; Sectors 2&3 (Lumut→Pauh, 264 km + Prai/Teknologi Tenaga Perlis laterals) followed. Neither source places any phase completion in 1993 — the closest documented dates bracketing it are 1992 (Phase II) and 1996-1998 (Phase III/Stage III). Since this row's own recorded length (2,623 km) and endpoints (Kertih→Perlis) only exist once Phase III/Stage III is complete, a single StartYear1=1993 understates when the full route described on this row was actually finished, and doesn't correspond to any single phase's completion either. This is a genuine, if modest, spec mismatch worth a research follow-up rather than a silent pass.
